title: Ensure sshd Ciphers are configured
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 5.1.4: Ensure sshd Ciphers are configured and do not include any weak ciphers from the configurable weak cipher list.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: weak_ciphers
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of weak SSH ciphers to audit for; default follows CIS Benchmark 5.1.4.

fields.name: weak_ciphers_found
fields.description: Comma-separated list of weak ciphers detected, or 'none' if no weak ciphers found

audit_script: sshd -T | grep -i '^ciphers' | grep -oPi '\b({{ weak_ciphers | replace(',', '|') }})\b' | sort -u

steps.name: Check if sshd is installed
steps.function: 1. Check whether OpenSSH server is installed by locating the sshd binary. If not found, the audit will be skipped.

steps.name: Check for weak sshd ciphers
steps.function: 2. Run the audit command using the configurable weak cipher list to detect any weak ciphers in the effective sshd configuration.

parameters.cmd: sshd -T | grep -i '^ciphers' | grep -oPi '\b({{ weak_ciphers | replace(',', '|') }})\b' | sort -u

steps.name: Evaluate audit result
steps.function: 3. Determine compliance status: if sshd is not installed, set cis_result=SKIP and weak_ciphers_found=none. If weak ciphers were found (non-empty _weak_ciphers_output), set cis_result=FAIL and weak_ciphers_found to the detected list. Otherwise set cis_result=PASS and weak_ciphers_found=none.

computations.cis_result: SKIP if sshd is not installed; PASS if no weak ciphers found; FAIL otherwise
computations.weak_ciphers_found: none if no weak ciphers or sshd absent; otherwise the detected weak cipher names joined by commas

steps.name: Generate audit report
steps.function:
4. Create a task named 'Generate audit report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
AUDIT REPORT — CIS 5.1.4
Reference: CIS Benchmark checkpoint 5.1.4
Then for each requirement: REQUIREMENT NN - {{ req_NN }}:
  With fields: Task, Command, Exit code, Data, Status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR), Details.
Include Weak Ciphers Found: {{ weak_ciphers_found }}.
End with OVERALL COMPLIANCE: section containing Result: {{{ cis_result }}}

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: 5. Output the overall compliance status and weak ciphers found to the caller.

steps.name: Handle task failure
steps.function: 6. Reached via rescue block or on_fail on unexpected task failure.

phases.name: Data Collection
phases.description: Execute read-only commands to check sshd installation and detect weak ciphers using the configurable weak cipher list.

phases.name: Analysis
phases.description: Evaluate collected data and determine compliance status.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the audit report and compliance result to the caller.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all audit tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all checks complete and report status
If the audit targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, report SKIP for all checks.
This is an AUDIT playbook — it MUST NOT make any changes to the system. All tasks must be read-only (shell commands, stat, slurp, command with check-only flags, etc.).
Any unexpected task failure is routed to step-06 (abort).
reference_procedure:
Run the following command to verify none of the "weak" ciphers are being used:
# sshd -T | grep -Pi --
'^ciphers\h+\"?([^#\n\r]+,)?((3des|blowfish|cast128|aes(128|192|256))- cbc|arcfour(128|256)?|rijndael-cbc@lysator\.liu\.se|chacha20- poly1305@openssh\.com)\b'
- IF - a line is returned, review the list of ciphers. If the line includes chacha20- poly1305@openssh.com, review CVE-2023-48795 and verify the system has been patched. No ciphers in the list below should be returned as they're considered "weak":
3des-cbc
aes128-cbc
aes192-cbc
aes256-cbc
